testTitle: 角色管理 › 验证列表页无删除角色入口 [CASE-000389]

coverage.text: 已登录系统且当前用户具有角色管理模块的访问权限
coverage.implementation: globalSetup authenticates admin; openRolesPage confirms authenticated access by loading the role-management column header.
openRolesPage navigates to /admin/roles through openModule and waits for the 角色编码 column header.

coverage.text: 检查每个角色行是否存在“删除”按钮或入口
coverage.implementation: expectRole filters the loaded data rows by the required role code and requires exactly one matching row.
openRolesPage asserts the four headers and exactly five populated role rows.

coverage.text: 每个角色行均不存在删除按钮或入口，无法进行删除操作
coverage.implementation: expectRole asserts the required role-code cell in the unique matching row.
